copy.tagline: 把 Slack 频道接入你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你开发的应用需要 Slack 聊天功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Slack channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need Slack chat in your app

howto.what: 给 NanoClaw 加上 Slack 渠道:从 channels 分支复制 Slack 适配器、注册测试和格式技能,安装 pinned 版本的适配器包,跑构建与注册测试,再收集 Slack 凭据、解析你的私信频道并重启服务。
howto.when: 当你要求给 NanoClaw 添加 Slack 渠道集成时接管。它先问事件投递方式:socket(Socket Mode,默认推荐)或 webhook。

say.text: 帮我给 NanoClaw 加上 Slack 集成,用 Socket Mode。
用 webhook 方式接入 Slack,我的服务端口 3000 有公网地址。

howto.what_en: Adds Slack to NanoClaw: copies the Slack adapter, registration test, and formatting skill from the channels branch, installs the pinned @chat-adapter/slack, builds and runs the test, then collects credentials, resolves your DM channel, and restarts.
howto.when_en: Use when you ask to add a Slack channel to NanoClaw. It first asks how Slack should deliver events: socket (Socket Mode, the default) or webhook.

say_en.text: Add Slack to NanoClaw using Socket Mode.
say_en.note: Walks you through app creation and xapp-/xoxb- tokens

say_en.text: Add Slack via webhook; port 3000 is publicly reachable.
say_en.note: Asks for the Signing Secret and Request URL setup

say_en.text: Resolve my Slack DM with the bot; my member ID is U0ABC12345.
